gap_details.2020-2021: First program year; no roster page existed (page first linked Aug 2021). Reconstructed: Miles Hudson PGY-1 (NPPES trainee NPI enumerated 2020-06-17 at Mayo AZ Shea Blvd address; PGY-2 in Nov 2021). Patra's 2020-21 status (fellow vs PGY-3) unknown; he is seen from 2021-22 to graduation 2025 so no exit is hidden. Phase 2: CC-MAIN-2019-04/2019-22/2020-10 retried OK, 0 records under the Arizona residency prefix. Complement 1/yr and the 2020 slot is Hudson's, so an unseen PGY-1 leaver would exceed complement.
gap_details.2011-2012..2019-2020: Treated as pre-program, not missing: Mayo GME neurosurgery index (college.mayo.edu/.../neurosurgery/, 2019-09-22) listed residencies only in Florida and Minnesota; mayo.edu/msgme (2012-2016) and mayo.edu/mayo-clinic-school-of-graduate-medical-education (2017-2018) neurologic-surgery trees contain only Florida/Minnesota residency paths. Earliest entrant with PGY consistent with a PGY-1 start is 2020. Caveat: no accreditation/history page found; Devi Patra (grad 2025, listed PGY-4 in 2021-22) implies nominal 2018 entry but he had prior neurosurgery residency (PGIMER) and Mayo AZ cerebrovascular fellowship, and PubMed shows him at Mayo Phoenix labs from 2018 -> taken as advanced-placement entry. A 2019 entrant (would be PGY-3 in 2021-22) is absent; cannot tell whether the program had no 2019 PGY-1 or one left before Nov 2021. Mayo Programs A-Z index (college.mayo.edu/academics/residencies-and-fellowships/programs-a-z/) first links the Arizona neurosurgery residency between captures 2021-07-24 (absent; 9 captures 2019-08..2021-07 all lack it) and 2021-08-18 (present).
gap_details.2022-2023: Only capture in the year is 2022-07-29 but content is advanced (Bathini PGY-1, all others +1) -> used as 2022-23. Next capture is 2024-03.
gap_details.2025-2026: 2025-07-19 capture still listed Patra PGY-7 alongside new PGY-1 Nguyen; used 2025-11-16 capture (Patra removed, matches alumni grad 2025).
gap_details.2019 entrant: No 2019 entrant: the program did not yet exist. Phase-2 Wayback audit of every college.mayo.edu/academics/residencies-and-fellowships/ URL Jun 2019-Oct 2021 (1217 URLs, any status) shows Arizona neurosurgery FELLOWSHIPS and FL/MN residencies but no neurologic-surgery-residency-arizona path; NPPES Neurological Surgery NPIs in Scottsdale/Phoenix AZ enumerated 2019 are all Barrow/St Joseph's/Phoenix Children's addresses, none at Mayo; first Mayo AZ NSGY trainee NPI is Hudson (Jun 2020); PubMed Mayo AZ neurosurgery affiliations 2019-21 show no unlisted resident (e.g. Karl Abi-Aad = research fellow, residency in Syracuse from 2020).
